The residence

Finished to be lived in — and to be seen.

Light-filled open-plan living opening to the deck · two-bedroom principal living quarters · a separate two-bedroom garden flatlet · double garage · and a rooftop built for Cape Town summers.

What sets it apart

Four reasons this home commands a premium.

Uninterrupted V&A & stadium views

Perched above Green Point, the home commands a sweeping outlook over the stadium, the working harbour and the Atlantic beyond — the view buyers at this level are truly paying for.

An income-generating flatlet

A self-contained two-bedroom garden flatlet with its own plunge pool, let on the short-stay market at around R1 million a year — a trophy home that helps pay for itself.

Rooftop entertainment deck

An expansive timber sun deck with an indoor braai room, bar, sunken hot tub and lounging terrace — effortless entertaining against the skyline.

Off-grid resilience

Full solar generation with battery inverters — uninterrupted, lower-cost living, and a genuine selling point to today's premium buyer.

A home that pays for itself
± R1 million / year

The self-contained garden flatlet, with its own plunge pool and private access, performs strongly on the short-stay market. For a buyer, that is a lifestyle home and a yielding asset — a rare combination on the Atlantic Seaboard, and a powerful argument for the asking price.
